about: The owner's 2010 Legacy B4 (BM), the portal's indicator teach run of 2026-11-19 (Save these readings), cut to the readings inside the steps and three identifiers: 0x432 (byte 5 a value the flasher's load moves, its bit 41 once offered as the right lamp), 0x3B1 (a counter in byte 5, a signed value in byte 2) and 0x451 (the coolant, a step of one during the right step). The master answered in 53-243 ms. No frame on this bus followed the lamps. Flip counters are stored without their trailing zero bytes (pad to 64).
